name: LifeMint 1.4.1
body:
LifeMint 1.4.1 refines shift planning and brings your recent days into focus.

• A redesigned Shift Planner for multiple work profiles — one-time shifts and weekly recurring templates with a new card-based editor
• Recent activity from the last three days across every LifeMint domain, right on Today
• Quick + Bonus actions on Work rows and a refined Weekly Review
• Records week picker with Monday-start weeks and profile-scoped tips
• Widgets and Apple Watch surfaces now follow your Life Ring priorities
• Rebalanced Ocean Collection creature rarities and reward pools

name: LifeMint 1.4.0
body:
LifeMint 1.4.0 makes it easier to begin, stay focused, and keep your week in view.

• A new modular Start page on Apple Watch for Study, Work, Expense, and Gym
• Start Study and Work from synced iPhone quick starts
• Clearer iPhone handoff for Expense and Gym
• Refined Watch navigation with Now first and Start one swipe away
• More reliable Apple Health connection and workout syncing
• Smoother onboarding, accessibility, and general performance improvements

name: LifeMint 1.3.0
body:
Version 1.3 introduces smarter shift planning, paycheck forecasting, reconciliation tools, and improved Pro access handling. We also improved reliability, localization, and overall performance.

Also in recent LifeMint builds: Earn / Spend / Train records, weekly review, and home actions for study, work, expense, and gym.

name: LifeMint 1.0.8
body:
What's New in This Version

Custom Modes: Personalize your focus sessions with Custom Emoji icons! 
Watch Sync: Your custom modes now sync automatically and permanently to your Apple Watch.
Send Feedback: Reach out to us directly via the new Feedback section in your Profile. 
UI Refinement: Enhanced Dark Mode support and optimized layouts for a smoother experience.
Bug Fixes: Squashed various UI bugs across both iPhone and Watch apps.
Language: Added French supportz!
